title: FinPerturb: decision stability of published LLM trading agents under meaning-preserving perturbation of news input
description: Harness, frozen scoring rules, read-out rule, channel-applicability audits and preregistration record for FinPerturb. Code is Apache-2.0; documentation under docs/ and the registration attachments are CC-BY 4.0. The confirmatory design is OSF Registration 1 (doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/ARFT9).
